title: [KBM] New editor: suspend the KBM engine while the remap dialog is open

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The four-path startup-gating candidate is unchanged and unbuilt. The minimal runner, Settings, module, editor and UI-test build chain is recorded with source and resource guards. One focused cross-process regression case is specified; its expected count is source-derived, not executed. An inert process harness checked argument forwarding, nonzero and thrown failures, process exit and stream disposal, but did not exercise the product entrypoint or repository build scripts. Exact-candidate compilation and an isolated interactive test must still establish mutex ownership, startup, focus, keyboard, engine-event and cleanup behavior. No author-facing action or review convergence is established.
